description: Pending Replies: mark a reply done: sent (default; the user replied, logged privately in the contact's history) or dismissed. Dayze sends nothing. By reply_id, or person_name / person_id when that person has exactly one unsent reply (otherwise the candidates come back and nothing changes). Marking sent writes one private interaction for the linked contact (not for an unlinked reply, and not twice); interaction in the result says what was written. Reopen with update_pending_reply status pending. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write. ($0.05; API key required)

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

name: resolve_pending_reply

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

interaction.description: The contact-history write-back of a reply marked sent by this call; null when nothing was marked sent now.

logged.description: True when this call wrote it.

reason.description: logged, unlinked, already_logged, gmail_sync_logged or storage_error

visibility.description: Always private: interactions are the owner's alone.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.

reply.description: One reply the user owes (Inbox → Pending Replies). Dayze never sends it.

approved_at.description: PHI-427: when the owner approved the draft and opened it in Gmail, or null. Dayze never sends; the Gmail sync closes the reply when the email goes out.

draft.description: The reply text saved for later.

due.description: Owed now: pending, or snoozed with snooze_until passed. False while a snooze runs, and when sent or dismissed.

person_id.description: Linked contact id; null when the reply is unlinked.

source.description: The email it answers, as ids only; null when none was saved.

state.description: unsent (pending or snoozed), sent (the owner replied) or dismissed

visibility.description: Always private: Pending Replies have no sharing setting.

resolved.description: True when this call changed the reply.

title: Resolve Pending Reply
